item.title: Speedrunners Already Breaking The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Remake
item.description: Speedrunners have had their hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for a couple of days now, and some funky tricks have already been discovered. In particular, the remake's addition of a jumping mechanic has enabled new speedrunning tactics that just weren't possible in the Nintendo 64 original or its 3DS remake.

item.title: Assassin's Creed Hexe Reportedly Delayed As New Assassin's Creed Games Leak
item.description: Some new reports regarding the Assassin's Creed series emerged last week, giving us a better idea of what to expect from Ubisoft's flagship series for the rest of the decade. While we learned about two Assassin's Creed titles for the first time, it has also been reported that the development of Assassin's Creed Hexe is taking longer than expected.

item.title: Magic’s Star Trek Set Doubles as a Must-Watch Guide to the Sci-Fi Franchise
item.description: Prerelease events for Magic ’s Star Trek begin this weekend before a global launch on Nov. 13. The set celebrates six decades of the franchise with cards featuring familiar characters, starships, and memorable adventures. Among them are 14 saga enchantments inspired by — and named after — 13 television episodes and one movie.

item.title: Cairn 'Belongs' Next to Death Stranding in ‘History of Grand Adventure Games'
item.description: Game Bakers co-founder and Cairn producer Audrey Leprince did not set out to “simulate climbing.” The vision was to build an action-adventure game about survival, obsession, sacrifice, and what drives someone to accomplish the impossible. With Cairn ’s new DLC On the Trail: Deep Water out now, Leprince spoke to Polygon about scaling the project and working with director Emeric Thoa to produce a project more meaningful than a simple sports game.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Beats The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim in One Major Way
item.description: After years spent dreaming of a remake or remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , the highest-rated video game of all time according to Metacritic , fans finally saw their wish fulfilled in 2026. Nintendo announced a remake for Switch 2 earlier this year, and the title arrived in stores this week.

item.title: Matt Mercer's Best Critical Role Quote Is Still the Most Inspiring Line in D&D History
item.description: Matthew Mercer is one of the world's most popular Dungeon Masters. Alongside other incredible DMs like Deborah Ann Woll, Brennan Lee Mulligan, and Aabria Iyengar, Mercer has undeniably shaped how players worldwide approach tabletop role-playing games. As Critical Role , the multimedia entertainment company Mercer co-founded, has grown and evolved over the years, one thing has remained constant: Mercer’s willingness to help other tabletop players. He is especially eager to support aspiring Dungeon Masters who hope to develop their skills and become as accomplished as he is, even appearing on the official Dungeons & Dragons YouTube page to provide assistance.

item.title: 68 Years Later, Peanuts’ Most Mysterious Character Is Finally Making Her Official Debut — But There's a Catch
item.description: There are some elements of Charles Schulz's Peanuts comic that have hardly aged at all, such as the characters' relationships or its focus on team sports. Most kids in America, before or since, have had the experience of being on a team where one kid is taking the game way too seriously while another seems barely aware of what's going on.

item.title: Bethesda's Most Reviled Game Becomes a 10/10 If You Ignore the Story
item.description: Recently, Bethesda dominated conversations simply by announcing that the long-awaited Elder Scrolls 6 has an official subtitle : Sentinel . We didn’t learn much more than that, but it was enough to keep us talking because that’s the sort of hold Bethesda has on us. Sometimes. There have been other instances, however, when the hold loosened.
